name: Finachub Mobile Money Checkout for WooCommerce (M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN)
author: bnyamesa

sections.description:
Upgrade to Pro | View Live Demo

Finachub Mobile Money Checkout for WooCommerce (M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN) is the most elegant and modular solution for accepting mobile money payments on your WordPress site. Supporting Safaricom M-Pesa (Kenya), MTN MoMo (Uganda, Ghana, Zambia, Cameroon), and Airtel Money (Africa), this plugin provides a seamless checkout experience for your customers.

Architected for Growth
Version 1.4.0 introduces a modular provider system, making the plugin faster, more reliable, and ready for future expansions.

Why Choose Finachub?

  • Modular Architecture: Truly supports multiple providers (M-Pesa, MTN, Airtel) through a clean, decoupled engine.
  • Modern Design: Stylish and elegant checkout interfaces and admin dashboards designed for conversion.
  • User Trust: Leverages familiar STK and USSD push technologies that customers already know.
  • Ready for Scaling: Simple to set up, but powerful enough to handle your growing business needs.

Standard vs. Pro
This Standard Edition allows you to initiate payments securely. For businesses looking to automate their workflow, the Pro Version offers automatic order updates, real-time status polling, and advanced transaction analytics.

Features

  • Integrated Provider Selector: A beautiful checkout UI for customers to choose their preferred mobile wallet.
  • Secure STK/USSD Prompts: Trigger payment requests directly on the customer’s phone.
  • Modern Admin Dashboard: Clean, intuitive, and high-performance management interfaces.
  • Developer Friendly: Modular code structure for easy auditing and extension.
  • Comprehensive Setup Guides: Step-by-step instructions for all providers included in the dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Mobile Money > Setup Guide and follow the instructions to configure your providers.
sections.faq:
Does it support automatic order updates?

Automatic status updates via webhooks/callbacks are a Pro Feature. In the Standard edition, you manually verify payments and update order statuses.

What providers are supported?

M-Pesa (Kenya), MTN MoMo (multiple countries), and Airtel Money (multiple countries).
sections.changelog:

  • IMPROVEMENT: Modernized frontend design for the waiting page and checkout selector.
  • IMPROVEMENT: Rebranded to “Mobile Money” for better inclusivity.
  • UPSELL: Enhanced Pro feature integration and visibility.
  • FIX: Cleaned up duplicate methods and optimized the autoloader.

1.3.2

  • Initial naming and minor UI fixes.
